Messages.Author: Mike Nudd
Messages.Body:
I have a number of queries that I hope LSJ (or anyone else) can answer
for me:

1) We recently had a newguy in our playgroup who reckoned that he
could put a Discipline Master card on an uncontrolled (face-down)
vampire. We all though that he could not do this, but the wording on
card IIRC does not confirm this. I can safely assume we were right
anyway?

2) I know that DotB has now changed so that it is unstackable, and
that the damage now occurs during the 'press phase' of combat. I can
assume that this damage is now circumvented by any form of S:CE?

3) If a bloodhunt is declared upon on of your own acting minions, can
you play reaction cards such as Pulling String, Kindred Coercion or
Dread Gaze during the referendum?

4) Is Dawn Operation, Weather Control, Undead Persistence and Amaranth
a valid combination for a minion in combat?

Thanks in advance for your comments.

Regards,

Mike Nudd
VEKN Prince of London

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <3a0ae4c6...@news.ftech.net>,

Mike Nudd <mi...@vekn.org.uk> wrote:
>
>I have a number of queries that I hope LSJ (or anyone else) can answer
>for me:
>

>1) We recently had a newguy in our playgroup who reckoned that he
>could put a Discipline Master card on an uncontrolled (face-down)
>vampire. We all though that he could not do this, but the wording on
>card IIRC does not confirm this. I can safely assume we were right
>anyway?

Yep. Cards cannot be played on minions in the uncontrolled area unless
there's text specifically allowing it (e.g. Brainwash).

>2) I know that DotB has now changed so that it is unstackable, and
>that the damage now occurs during the 'press phase' of combat. I can
>assume that this damage is now circumvented by any form of S:CE?

Hm. As written, yeah. That's kind of annoying. LSJ, can you confirm this?

>3) If a bloodhunt is declared upon on of your own acting minions, can
>you play reaction cards such as Pulling String, Kindred Coercion or
>Dread Gaze during the referendum?

Nope. On the other hand, neither can anyone else. Bloodhunt referenda
aren't actions, and thus cannot be modified or reacted to. [6.5.6]

>4) Is Dawn Operation, Weather Control, Undead Persistence and Amaranth
>a valid combination for a minion in combat?

Yes, assuming the minion possesses the appropriate Disciplines.

gomi
